title: CANFAR · Efficiency & Waste
description: Where the platform is holding capacity that nobody is using, and who to talk to about it.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Metrics backend the panels query. Seeded at install time from grafanaDashboards.datasourceName; any other Prometheus-type datasource stays selectable here.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Namespace holding CANFAR session workloads. Set at install time from the chart's resolved workload namespace.

list.name: community
list.label: Community
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/community` pod label. Kueue ClusterQueue / fair-share grouping dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/project` pod label. Kueue LocalQueue dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: flavor
list.label: Flavor
list.description: `fixed` when the memory request equals the limit, otherwise `flexible`.

list.name: accelerator
list.label: Accelerator
list.description: `gpu` when the session requested GPUs, otherwise `none`. Exact GPU count comes from the nvidia.com/gpu resource request, not from this label.

panels.title: CPU wasted
panels.description: Requested-minus-used CPU integrated over the dashboard range. This is capacity the scheduler could not give to anyone else.

panels.title: Memory wasted
panels.description: Requested-minus-used memory integrated over the dashboard range.

panels.title: CPU efficiency
panels.description: Used ÷ requested CPU across running sessions. Above 100% the session is bursting beyond what it reserved.

panels.title: RAM efficiency
panels.description: Working set ÷ requested memory across running sessions. Above 100% the session is bursting beyond what it reserved.

panels.title: Low-CPU sessions
panels.description: Running sessions using less than $low_efficiency_threshold of their requested CPU.

panels.title: Low-RAM sessions
panels.description: Running sessions using less than $low_efficiency_threshold of their requested memory.

panels.title: CPU efficiency by session kind
panels.description: Working-set CPU divided by requested CPU, for running sessions only. Sustained values under 25% mean the platform is holding capacity that nobody is using.

panels.title: RAM efficiency by session kind
panels.description: Working-set RAM divided by requested RAM, for running sessions only. Sustained values under 25% mean the platform is holding capacity that nobody is using.

panels.title: Sessions by requested CPU
panels.description: How many running sessions sit in each whole-core request bucket. A long tail on the right with poor efficiency is the over-requesting problem. Buckets are sorted numerically.

panels.title: Sessions by requested memory
panels.description: Running sessions bucketed into 2 GiB memory-request bands. Buckets are sorted numerically.

panels.title: Requested CPU distribution over time
panels.description: Session count per CPU-request bucket, over time.

panels.title: Requested memory distribution over time
panels.description: Session count per 2 GiB memory-request bucket, over time.

panels.title: Per-user footprint and efficiency
panels.description: Sort ascending by CPU or RAM efficiency to find who to talk to first; the footer totals show the platform-wide picture. GPU efficiency is absent because no exporter reports GPU utilisation. Click a user to open it in Session Drilldown.

value.title: Open Session Drilldown for this user

panels.title: CPU percentiles by session kind
panels.description: Per-pod peak CPU over the range, reduced to percentiles across sessions of each kind. This is the 'Resource Percentiles (By Type)' table from the CANFAR metrics specification. Click a kind to open it in Session Drilldown.

value.title: Open Session Drilldown for this kind

panels.title: Memory percentiles by session kind
panels.description: Per-pod peak Memory over the range, reduced to percentiles across sessions of each kind. This is the 'Resource Percentiles (By Type)' table from the CANFAR metrics specification. Click a kind to open it in Session Drilldown.

value.title: Open Session Drilldown for this kind
